_comment: Optional operator override for model pricing used to estimate spend. Copy this file to pricing.json (repo root, gitignored) and edit — or point CLAUDE_CODE_LOG_PRICING at a file anywhere. Every field is optional: a file with only `opus` under `rates` overrides just that family, leaving the others on the built-in table. Rate arrays are USD per 1M tokens, in order [input, output, cacheWrite, cacheRead]. See server/pricing.ts.
